blocks.html: Robinsons Place Antique Marks the Province’s Commercial Progress. Opens on July 15 .

Named after the industrious black ants, or the ‘hantik’, the province of Antique, found in the easternmost side of the Panay Islands, is home to over half a million people diligently dedicated to the bounties of its land and sea. Its capital, San Jose de Buenavista is a fast-growing first-class municipality that teems with tourism and commercial potential. Out to cement its retail hold in the country’s emerging townships, Robinsons Malls is set to change the landscape of Antique as it opens the new Robinsons Place Antique.
The new mall will open on July 15 and is set to become a vibrant commercial center in the capital town’s heartland. It will feature more than 60 tenants spread over two storeys of prime retail space.

Anchored by Robinsons Malls’ retail partners, such as Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Appliances, Handyman, Daiso, and Quantum Amusement, Robinsons Antique aims to offer the same level of commercial conveniences found in Robinsons Malls’ urban retail destinations.
Its modern design by renowned architecture firm ASYA Design, features a blueprint of wide walkways, well-considered and convenient entrances, exits, escalators, parking spaces, and public spots. Its intelligently lit and well-ventilated retail areas are built with premium quality materials and of the topmost construction standards that are set to elevate the shopping experiences of the Antique residents.

Its accessibility from the town center, as well as its thoughtful transport hub makes the new Robinsons Place Antique a bustling center point where the province’s lifestyle, leisure, and commercial pursuits all converge.

This new retail development is Robinsons’ 40th mall development in the Philippines, and the 9th in the Visayas. With a long tradition of pioneering retail excellence in the country’s most promising locations, as well as a progressive stance of boldly introducing newer commercial experiences in localities brimming with potential, Robinsons Malls aims to bring its reliable brand of developmental expertise to every corner of the country.
